Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in data extraction and verification at Step 4. While the WebSurfer correctly identified that the Wikipedia page showed George V was born on "3 June 1865", the Planner incorrectly analyzed this result, stating: "Died 20 January 1936 (aged 70), confirming the birth year as 1866." This is a mathematical and logical error; if someone died in 1936 at age 70, they were born in 1865 (1936 - 70 = 1866 is incorrect for age calculation in this context, or simply the text explicitly says "3 June 1865"). The Planner failed to read the explicit birth date provided in the text and instead performed a flawed calculation or hallucinated the year 1866. This error led to a cascade of incorrect instructions to verify the year 1866, wasting subsequent steps on sources that would have confirmed 1865.
